# Kleap

> > Kleap is an AI-powered no-code platform for building websites, generating QR codes, and creating marketing content with enterprise-grade infrastructure.

Kleap Technologies SA, based in Switzerland, provides AI-driven tools for website building, business idea generation, social media content creation, and QR code generation. The platform leverages technologies like Vercel, Supabase, and Stripe, with GDPR compliance and enterprise features including SSO and 99.9% uptime guarantees.

## Key Topics

- AI website builder
- QR code generator
- No-code platform
- GDPR compliance
- Enterprise AI solutions
- Domain name generation
- Social media content tools
- Business idea generator
- vCard and WiFi QR codes
- Instagram bio generator
- Vercel infrastructure
- Supabase backend
- Stripe payments
- SOC 2 compliance
- Multi-platform support (iOS, Android, Google Lens)
